findings.finding: Q3 2026 was pre-released by ad-hoc on 12 Nov at 13:17 CET, before the window opened. Adj. EBITDA +8% to EUR 14.1m at a 16.6% margin, revenue +6%, guide confirmed. EUR 2.4m of one-off staff-reduction costs are framed as cutting the cost base in later quarters. Net debt rose to EUR 83m, almost all from the dividend and buyback. The detailed report inside the window should restate these numbers, leaving only a small residual of a quarter the market has had about 4 hours of thin trading to digest.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Day after earlier ad-hocs and detail days: Q1 ad-hoc 11 May 2026 -3.3% on the day, then +5.8% the next. H1 ad-hoc 6 Aug 2026 +2.7%, then -1.5% the next; H1 report day 14 Aug -1.85%. Q3 2025 detail day 14 Nov 2025 +0.6% (Yahoo daily bars). The next-day follow-through has no consistent sign.
findings.original_quote: Nach dem margenstarken dritten Quartal bestätigt Allgeier die Guidance für das Geschäftsjahr 2026 ... Ein wesentlicher Teil entfällt dabei auf den Abbau von Personal. Diese Maßnahmen entlasten die Kostenbasis in den Folgequartalen. (Translation: after a high-margin Q3 Allgeier confirms its 2026 guidance; a significant part of the one-offs relates to staff reductions, which will relieve the cost base in subsequent quarters.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is a regulated ad-hoc that traded for about 4 hours before the window opened. The seal at 13.85 sits about 1% above the pre-ad-hoc 13.70. Only a thin name's incomplete digestion is left, so the finding is near 0. If it were fully unpriced, the 12 Nov tape would show no volume after 12:17 UTC; it shows the day's largest bar.
